meta.scope: Iraq Batch 8 — Agriculture (wheat/barley), electricity generation, and defence densification.

candidates.title: Agriculture production statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from national and USDA-aligned sources
candidates.description: Statistics on major crop production. Wheat and barley are the principal cereals; production is sensitive to water availability, conflict disruption and input constraints. Agriculture remains important for rural livelihoods and food security despite oil dominance.
candidates.notes: Core primary-sector production node under oil dominance.

candidates.title: Wheat production statistics
candidates.description: Focused statistics on wheat production. Wheat is the dominant cereal; recent seasons have shown recovery in output relative to drought- and conflict-affected years.

candidates.title: Electricity generation and capacity statistics
candidates.description: Installed generation capacity and electricity production statistics. Capacity is in the high-30s GW range; generation relies heavily on gas and thermal plants, with chronic shortfalls relative to peak demand and fuel/availability constraints.
candidates.notes: Core power-system statistical product. Chronic reliability issues are a structural feature.

candidates.title: Defence and security expenditure statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from budget and international compilations
candidates.description: Statistics on defence and security spending. Continuously referenced in fiscal, security and post-conflict analysis; security-related outlays form a material share of the federal budget alongside the wage bill.

candidates.title: Iraq agriculture–power–defence densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from agricultural, electricity and security sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding agriculture and wheat statistics, electricity generation/capacity, and defence/security expenditure into a coherent primary–energy–security residual layer.
